title: One Afternoon at the Pond
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：biology　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 biology 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 my aunt was taught ① a biology that stopped at the names, and she said the stopping was the whole of the lesson. The ② biology, meaning the subject and not the living thing, was examined in June and was forgotten by September; a biology, she said, is the only science that is tested on what it calls things.

Every ③ biology in that school was taught from the same chart, and the ④ biology of the pond, meaning the one term they actually went outside and not either of those, was the only one anybody remembered. A biology, my grandfather said, is nine parts naming and one part a day you are allowed to look; my aunt said the looking is the part they never timetable.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ biology was the whole of the creature, meaning the life and not the subject. The ⑥ biology, meaning the way a body works and not any of that, is the only thing in an animal that everybody depends on and nobody can see; a biology, she said, is either something you are taught or the only word that means both a subject and a life. He said the life came first.

By 1969 the ⑦ biology had become a photograph in a textbook, and the textbook had become an argument about what to leave out. The ⑧ biology of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in April, was nine years of names and one afternoon at the pond; a biology, she said, is either the chart on the wall or the reason you learned to kneel down. He said the kneeling was never examined.

The ⑨ biology I remember is the one of the pond, which was taught once and was never repeated. A ⑩ biology, my grandmother said in 1971, is the only science that improves by being forgotten; every biology, she said, is a life that has agreed to look like a subject. She said the life was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 生物学（这门学科）
B. n. 生物学（指这门课，与生物本身相对）
C. 固定搭配：be taught a biology 被教一门生物学
D. n. 生物学（指那所学校每一门／每一次）
E. n. 生物学（指关于池塘的那一次）
F. n. 生理机能；生命机制（指生物的生命活动）
G. n. 生理（抽象：身体运作这件事）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a biology that stopped at the names
The biology, meaning the subject and not the living thing
biology was the whole of the creature
The biology, meaning the way a body works
the biology had become a photograph in a textbook
The biology of the whole thing
A biology, my grandmother said in 1971

answers.why: be taught a biology 意为“被教一门生物学”，1952 年姑姑被教了一门只讲到名称为止的生物学。
biology 意为“生物学”，指这门课而不是生物本身，它六月考试，九月就忘光了。
biology 指那所学校每一门生物学，每一门都用同一张挂图教。
biology 指关于池塘的那一次（他们唯一真正出门去上的那一次），是唯一有人记得的。
biology 意为“生理机能、生命机制”，指那个生物的生命活动，母亲说 biology 就是那个生物的全部。
biology 为抽象用法，指身体运作这件事，是一个动物身上人人都依赖、却没人看得见的东西。
biology 意为“生物学”，到 1969 年这个 biology 成了教科书里的一张照片。
biology 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，姑姑四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年的名称和一个在池塘边的下午。
biology 意为“生物学”，我记得的是关于池塘那一次，它只教过一回，再没重复过。
biology 为抽象总称，祖母说生物学是唯一会因为被遗忘而变好的科学。
